jec-synthetic.xls contains four authored synthetic rows for offline parser tests.
It is not copied from the JEC corpus or publisher workbook. Dedicated to CC0.

Generated with xlwt 1.3.0, worksheet ALL_NEW, no header, four string columns:
row ID, Japanese, English, Chinese. It tests complete sentences, X templates,
numeric wave-dash ranges and quotation placeholders. No upstream requests or
spreadsheet-writing dependency is required to run the tests.
